cpu: Apple M1 Pro, 8 logical CPUs (6 performance + 2 efficiency)
workload: experiment --mode correctness (20,000 keys, concurrency 64, RF=3, OwnerOnly, 128-byte values, 10 peak nodes), HASHRING_PROFILE_WRITES=1
design: 5 variants x 6 reps, variant order rotated each rep; threads given as driver/coordinator/node
note: Two runs (all2-1, coord8-2) failed at scale-out with 'concurrent mutator finished without a successful mutation'; their initial put/get and node pressure were recorded before the failure and are included.
